北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and hot, remember sun protection and hydration!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波中雨，记得带伞，湿度高，小心潮湿！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has moderate rain, remember your umbrella, high humidity, watch out for dampness!
宁波.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感较热，注意防暑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels quite hot, remember to prevent heatstroke!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感闷热，多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is partly cloudy and muggy, drink plenty of water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感偏热，有风但仍需补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy and feels warm, windy but still stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云有大风，气温高，注意防风防暑！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is partly cloudy with strong winds and high temperatures, mind the wind and heat!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雨，请注意行车安全，带好雨具！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has heavy rain, please drive safely and bring your rain gear!
南京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感炎热，记得多喝水，防晒哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels scorching hot, remember to drink plenty of water and wear sunscreen!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感高温，务必防暑降温！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy with extremely high perceived temperatures, be sure to prevent heatstroke and cool down!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热，体感炎热，注意防晒补水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot, feels scorching, remember sun protection and hydration!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温适中，但湿度不低哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, temperatures are moderate, but humidity is quite high!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，风力较大，注意添衣保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy with strong winds, remember to add clothes to stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴热，体感炎热，注意防晒和补水！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and hot, feels scorching, remember sun protection and hydration!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感微热，注意补充水分！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy, feels slightly warm, remember to hydrate!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感闷热，多喝水，注意防暑！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels muggy, drink plenty of water and prevent heatstroke!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，风力较大，体感湿润，记得添衣！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast with strong winds, feels humid, remember to add clothes!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云有风，湿度较大，注意防风和保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy and windy with high humidity, mind the wind and keep warm!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，体感闷热潮湿，注意防潮防暑！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast, feels muggy and humid, remember to prevent dampness and heatstroke!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨，带伞出行，小心路滑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has moderate rain, take an umbrella and watch out for slippery roads!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
